summary: Response Acceleration Layer testing complete. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Fixed critical bug in DealManagement.js where 'engData is not defined' error crashed the page. All frontend UI features verified: Acciones Pendientes block, pending badges, Q&A tab badge, RESPONDER AHORA navigation, and ConversationPage question sorting.

backend: GET /api/conversations/pending/seller - returns 200 with pending_questions, total_pending, buyers_waiting
GET /api/conversations/pending/seller - returns most_urgent field with buyer_name, pending_hours
GET /api/conversations/pending/seller - pending questions have all required fields (urgency, intent_score, deal_stage)
GET /api/conversations/pending/seller - priority sorting (oldest first → highest intent → most advanced stage)
GET /api/engagements/seller/interesados - includes pending_questions, oldest_pending_hours, pending_urgency per buyer
GET /api/engagements/deal/{deal_id} - includes pending_questions, oldest_pending_hours, pending_urgency per engagement
POST /api/conversations/{id}/questions - notification uses 'X esta esperando tu respuesta' format
Nudges have required structure (id, type, priority, title, message)
GET /api/conversations/{id} - returns questions with status field for sorting
Questions have valid status (PENDING, ANSWERED, CLOSED)
E2E: Buyer creates question → Seller sees in pending → Seller answers → Pending count decreases
frontend: SellerDashboard shows 'Acciones Pendientes' block with count, buyers waiting, most urgent
SellerDashboard shows individual pending question preview items (max 3)
SellerDashboard RESPONDER AHORA button navigates to correct Q&A page
SellerInteresados shows pending badge with count per buyer
SellerInteresados shows Q&A link for buyers with conversation
DealManagement Q&A tab shows badge with pending count number
DealManagement Interesados tab shows pending count in Q&A link per buyer
ConversationPage shows questions sorted: PENDING oldest first, then ANSWERED, then CLOSED
ConversationPage shows RESPONDER and CERRAR PREGUNTA buttons for seller
